the heavy quark potential model with QCD short-distance behavior gives a reliable description of the properties of heavy quarkonium states in a wide mass range.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heavy quark potential model gives a reliable and accurate description of the quarkonium spectrum, including the very heavy quarkonium states.
the masses of the first ten S-waves of heavy quarkonium resonant levels are well known, but the corresponding widths are not.
there are no surprises in the heavy quarkonium sector.

the masses and widths of the lowest S-wave quarkonia and the color-octet and sextet states are not very sensitive to the QCD scale ΛMS(4), and that the masses and the widths of the higher S-wave states are also rather stable with respect to the variation of ΛMS(4).
